PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

2. When learning Computer Software, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Software.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Software.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer Software.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Software.

3. When learning Plane Geometry, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Plane Geometry.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Plane Geometry.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Plane Geometry.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Plane Geometry.

   B. Skip safety briefings for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team

   A. Skip safety briefings for Fire Safety.

   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

10. When learning Dimensioning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Composite Materials.

   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Safety.

16. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

----
